title: Mexican Lemongrass Chicken
description: A twist on traditional Mexican chicken dishes, with the addition of lemongrass for a bright and citrusy flavor.
instructions: Season the chicken breasts with cumin, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Heat coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped lemongrass and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the chicken breasts and cook for 2-3 minutes, until browned on both sides.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with additional lemongrass if desired.
